_comment: Curated character catalog. Schema per VIDEO-GENERATION-PLAN.md §5.3. Real players carry real likenesses (AI/parody disclosure is burned into every video). Wardrobe strings always end with the no-lettering rule — that is what keeps garbled text off the kit. reference_images are AI-generated stills produced by `python -m app.video.catalog_build` with the SAME image model used for scene keyframes; empty means none generated yet and the prompt falls back to pure text description.
